title: OpenAI Set For $850B Valuation In Blockbuster Raise Backed By Wall Street Giants - Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT)
summary: OpenAI is nearing an $850 billion valuation with a new $10 billion venture-capital raise, shifting focus and discontinuing its Sora video platform to prioritize enterprise AI adoption. It also competes with Anthropic for private equity partnerships.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights a significant funding achievement and strategic business moves that indicate growth and potential in the AI market, hence the positive sentiment.
